account.error_current: That is not your current password.
account.error_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
account.error_short: The new password is too short.
account.error_username: The password cannot be your username.
account.intro: Password and interface language. Changing the password does not sign you out here.
account.rule: At least {count} characters. A long sentence beats a short password full of symbols.
account.title: Your account
admin.default_password: This account still has its first password (ADMIN_PASSWORD from .env, or the generated initial-admin-password file). Change it before anyone else reaches this address.
admin.masking_off: No entity type is selected, so the hub masks nothing: text reaches the provider whole.
admin.own_password: Change your own password on your account page
app.name: PolGate
app.pitch: Employees talk to a cloud model while personal data is masked locally and restored in the answer.
app.tagline: A safe AI hub for your company
auth.locked: Too many failed attempts. This account is locked for a few minutes.
chat.empty: An empty message will not be sent.
chat.empty_body: Write as usual. Personal data becomes placeholders on the way out and comes back in the answer.
chat.error_judge: The second-stage review is unavailable and the policy says to hold messages when that happens. Nothing was sent.
chat.error_refused: The hub stopped this message because it found an unmasked value it treats as sensitive. Nothing was sent.
chat.extra_terms_hint: e.g. a project name or a client's nickname
chat.indexing: Indexing the attachment to find the passages that match the question…
chat.masked_hint: How many fragments were replaced with tokens before sending.
chat.none_body: Start a new conversation. Earlier ones may have been deleted under the retention policy.
chat.nothing_masked_hint: The hub found nothing to mask in this message. Open the preview to see what the model received.
chat.placeholder: Type a message… personal data is masked before it leaves the company
chat.print_note: Printed from the hub. Contains personal data: handle as a paper record.
chat.protected_hint: Personal data is masked before sending and restored in the answer.
chat.search_capped: The attachment is longer than the hub searches: questions only cover its first part.
chat.sidebar_hint: Conversations are stored on your server, encrypted.
chat.sweep_warning: The answer contains data that was not in your message.
chat.unprotected_hint: The administrator cleared every entity type. Your messages reach the model exactly as you write them.
error.403_body: This part of the hub is for an administrator. If you think you should see it, ask whoever set up your account.
error.404_body: The page, conversation or file you asked for does not exist, or it belongs to somebody else.
error.409_body: That message has already been sent, or it waited too long. Write it again.
error.413_body: The hub accepts files up to 10 MB. Cut out the part you need, or split the document.
error.422_body: Something is missing or in the wrong format. Go back and fill the form in again.
error.429_body: This account is locked for a few minutes. Try again shortly.
error.generic_body: The request did not go through. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell your administrator.
files.approved_flash: The file is attached to the conversation.
files.image_too_large: The picture has too many pixels to read (the limit is 50 million). Save it at a smaller size.
files.judge_unavailable: The second-stage review is unavailable and the policy says to hold files when that happens. The file was not kept.
files.rejected_flash: The file was rejected and deleted.
files.review_hint: The file on the left, what the model will see on the right. Approve to attach it.
files.too_large: File is too large (10 MB limit).
files.unpacks_too_large: Unpacked, this file is too large to read safely. Save a smaller part of the document.
files.unreadable: The file could not be read. It may be damaged or password-protected.
landing.f1_body: Personal data is replaced on your own server before anything reaches the provider.
landing.f2_body: Every message shows exactly what the model received.
landing.f3_body: PDF, Word, Excel and CSV are masked on upload, before they join the conversation.
landing.f4_body: We record entity types and counts, never the values themselves.
policy.allowlist_hint: Public platforms and tools people talk about: Facebook, Google Ads, Canva. Polish case forms match as well (na Facebooku, w Canvie). Only names a model took for a person, a company or a place are released — numbers, e-mail addresses and the list beside it are always masked.
policy.denylist_hint: Clients, projects and companies a model may miss. Letter case does not matter; put every inflected form on a line of its own.
policy.entities_hint: Clearing every box switches masking off. The hub keeps working and stops protecting anything.
policy.retention_hint: An empty field means keep forever. The hourly job really does delete what is past its date.
policy.search_hint: A file longer than the attachment budget is no longer cut after its beginning: each question sends the model the passages that match it. The passages are masked like the whole file, and their vectors come from the embedding model set in EMBEDDING_MODEL. A local one is best, so the document never leaves the server.
policy.search_unconfigured: The search is off because EMBEDDING_MODEL is not set. Until it is, long files are cut as before and no text goes to an embedding model.
stats.empty: Nothing yet. Send a first message.
